description: This file is a Markdown document providing documentation and internal module details for a buffer queue (`bufq`) used in the curl networking library. It describes functions, data structures, and memory management for managing I/O buffers within the project.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_init
methods.description: Initializes a bufq with specified chunk size and maximum chunks.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a bufq.

methods.name: Curl_bufq_reset
methods.description: Resets a bufq to an empty state.
